note: Open list. A record may name a region not listed here; validate.py warns so it can be added. Regions are the tradition's own geography, not administrative units.

entries.name: The Carolinas
entries.note: both states together; use when a node belongs to the whole tradition

entries.name: Eastern North Carolina
entries.note: the Coastal Plain, east of the fall line and roughly east of Raleigh; 'Down East' further out toward the coast

entries.name: The North Carolina Piedmont
entries.note: Lexington, the Triad, Charlotte; 'Western' or 'Lexington-style' in barbecue talk

entries.name: The South Carolina Midlands
entries.note: Columbia and the counties around it, including the Dutch Fork; the mustard belt

entries.name: The Pee Dee
entries.note: the northeast of the state along the Pee Dee River: Florence, Hemingway, Kingstree, Marion

entries.name: The Upstate
entries.note: Greenville, Spartanburg, the Piedmont of South Carolina

entries.name: The American South
entries.note: for nodes shared with the wider region
